answer: Re-attestations are stored in quartz and ridge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the pigment graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2745 identities would post 1635 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
